demandEvidence.reason: iFixit question (2025-03-07, BES878, three beeps, answer is only a video link) checked. Search also found independent home-barista threads (hot water stops and beeps after 5 s, air lock cleared; steam stops after a few pumps with three beeps) and ProductReview Q&A.

competitorGap.reason: Breville's support article lumps the shot cut-out in with grind and dose and never explains the three beeps. Other results are single-case forum anecdotes and JustAnswer pages, with no diagnosis order by symptom scope.

valueAddWithoutExperience.reason: A symptom-scope fault tree can be built from Breville's support steps, the manual and repeated owner reports without hands-on testing. It would ask whether the fault affects shots only or water and steam too, and whether it started after a filter change or descale, then route to air lock, filter, flow meter or warranty.

evidenceFeasibility.reason: The manual, Breville's support article and several owner threads support the free fixes. Breville publishes no meaning for the three beeps, so flow-meter attribution and repair costs rest on owner reports and must be hedged.

commercialFit.reason: The decision is honest: fix it for free, claim the warranty, repair or replace. Keeping the machine is the default, and the buy path (filter, descaler, replacement machine) only applies when the out-of-warranty quote is high.

overlap.reason: Different from the sour/bitter post and the descale routine. It touches the maintenance-alert-key tool and descaling content only lightly, and should link to them rather than duplicate them.
